facility.name: Ancient Altar
entries: An Ancient Altar is a solemn chamber where you can make offerings to mysterious forces.

entries.name: Empower: Purge Haunted Facility
entries: You commission your hireling to lead a ritual that takes 7 days, during which time you must remain in the Bastion. At the end of the ritual, you must offer a worthy sacrifice, which can be monetary (1,000 GP) or blood (the fresh corpse of at least one Large creature or four Medium creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead). If you make a blood sacrifice, roll on the {@book Bastion Hauntings table|RHW|3|Bastion Hauntings}. Once the ritual is complete, the sacrifice is destroyed. Choose a Haunted special facility in this Bastion or in a Bastion connected to this one; that facility is no longer Haunted.

entries.name: Blasphemous Charm
entries: After spending a Long Rest in your Ancient Altar, you gain a magical {@reward Blasphemous Charm|RHW|Charm} that lasts for 7 days or until you use it.

facility.name: Artificer's Forge
entries: An Artificer's Forge includes two magewright hirelings who are skilled in creating magic items.

entries.name: Crafting Assistants
entries: If you {@book create a magic item|XDMG|2|Creating a Magic Item} in your Bastion using the rules in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}, one or both of this facility's hirelings can assist you, reducing the time required for the crafting.

entries.name: Craft: Magic Item
entries: When you issue the Craft order to this facility, you commission the facility's hirelings to craft a {@book Common or an Uncommon magic item|XDMG|6|Magic Items} chosen by you from the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}. The facility has the tool required to craft the item, and the hirelings have proficiency with that tool as well as proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|XPHB} skill. The two hirelings assist each other, reducing the time required to craft the item. If the item allows its user to cast any spells from it, the hirelings have those spells prepared.

entries.name: Charge Refreshment
entries: Whenever a magic item in your Bastion regains charges, it regains 1 extra expended charge.

facility.name: Cabinet of Curiosities
entries: A Cabinet of Curiosities is a small salon, closet space, or antechamber where you can keep and catalog peculiar objects and fascinating oddities.

entries.name: Trade: Acquire Curios
entries: When you issue the Trade order to this facility, you supply this facility's hireling with a certain amount of gold and commission them to purchase strange items from unusual sources. It takes 28 days for the hireling to return to the Bastion with one or more magic items for you. Your investment determines the rarity of these items, and the quantity of magic items depends on the number of Haunted special facilities in your Bastion at the time of the hireling's return, as shown on the Curio Investment and Curios Collected tables.

To determine how many magic items your hireling brings back, count the Haunted special facilities in your Bastion, then roll the die indicated in the Magic Items Acquired column on the Curios Collected table. The DM rolls on the Cursed Item Chance ({@dice 1d100}) column to determine whether one of the magic items carries a curse. The DM chooses which item is cursed and establishes the nature of the curse.

For each magic item acquired, roll on a table in the "{@book Random Magic Items|XDMG|9}" section in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG} of the corresponding rarity to determine what the item is. (Select the treasure theme randomly.)

facility.name: Construct Forge
entries: A Construct Forge is used to create Constructs.

entries.name: Recruit: Construct
entries: When you issue the Recruit order to this facility, you commission the facility's hirelings to craft a Construct from the Forge Constructs table. The construction takes the time and costs you the amount listed in the table.

Constructs made in this facility count as Bastion Defenders. Deduct any you lose from your Bastion Defenders roster. You can choose not to count one or more of these creatures as Bastion Defenders, in which case they can't be called on to defend the Bastion. Instead, they act in accordance with their nature and use their stat blocks in the {@book Monster Manual|XMM}.

entries.caption: Forge Constructs
footnotes: *{@creature Warforged Titan|ERLW|The Warforged Titan stat block} appears in {@book Eberron: Rising from the Last War|ERLW}. Creating new Warforged Titans is illegal under the terms of the Treaty of Korth, which ended the Last War. Violating that treaty risks reigniting open war across Khorvaire.

facility.name: Dragonmark Outpost

otherSummary.entry: Renown 10+ with any {@book dragonmarked house|EFA|5|Dragonmarked House Renown}

entries: A Dragonmark Outpost is an area set aside for the use of your dragonmarked house. The hireling is a house agent and serves as a liaison between you and your superiors in the house.
When you add this facility to your Bastion, your Renown Score with your house increases by 1.

entries.name: Dragonmark Empowerment (Requires Any Dragonmark Feat)
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in your Bastion, you gain one extra spell slot of level 2. You can use this spell slot to cast only a spell you have prepared because of a {@book Dragonmark feat|EFA|2|Dragonmark Feats}.

entries.name: Empower: House Favor
entries: When you issue the Empower order to this facility, you instruct your hireling to call in a favor from your dragonmarked house. You can use any benefit of your house that your Renown Score affords you (as described in {@book chapter 5|EFA|5|Dragonmarked House Renown}), and this favor doesn't count against the total number of favors available to you. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until your Renown Score with your house increases.

facility.name: Infirmary
entries: An Infirmary provides emergency healing and continual care to injured or sick Bastion occupants.

entries.name: Craft Options
entries: When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following options:

items.name: Craft:
items.entry: Antitoxin. You commission the facility's hirelings to craft two vials of {@item Antitoxin|XPHB}. The work takes 7 days and costs no money. You can spend 50 GP during the creation process to enhance one of the vials of Antitoxin, or 100 GP to enhance both. An enhanced Antitoxin ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition on the creature that drinks it. An enhanced Antitoxin loses this enhancement after 28 days.

items.name: Craft:
items.entry: Enhanced Potion of Healing. You commission this facility's hirelings to increase the potency of up to two {@item Potion of Healing|XDMG|Potions of Healing}. You must provide the potions to be enhanced, and the process takes 14 days to complete. A Potion of Healing becomes a {@item Potion of Greater Healing|XDMG|Potion of Healing (greater)}. When you reach level 13 you can provide up to two Potions of Healing (greater), each of which becomes a {@item Potion of Superior Healing|XDMG|Potion of Healing (superior)}.

entries.name: Triage
entries: When your Bastion is attacked and you roll a number of dice to determine how many Bastion Defenders are lost, you can reroll a number of those dice equal to the number of hirelings this facility has. You must use the new roll.

entries.name: Enlarging the Facility
entries: You can enlarge your Infirmary to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. If you do so, the Infirmary gains two hirelings, and the number of Antitoxins or Potions of Healing you can enhance at a time increases to four.

facility.name: Inquisitive Agency
entries: This facility is an office for an inquisitive agency—either the headquarters of an agency you control or a branch office for a larger agency (such as {@book Middle Dura|EFA|4|Middle Dura} or {@book Karr'Aashta's Investigations|EFA|4|Karr'Aashta's Investigations}, both of which are discussed in chapter 4). Its one hireling is a secretary who maintains an extensive directory of useful contacts and helpful agents.

entries.name: Research: Information Gathering
entries: When you issue the Research order to this facility, you commission the agency's secretary to gather information from contacts and agents regarding a specific individual you designate, assembling a comprehensive picture of that person's activities during the previous 7 days and over the course of the next 7 days, within 10 miles of your Bastion. Unless the DM deems that certain information is beyond these agents' ability to uncover, you learn the following information:

items: Where the person is and has been staying
What they've spent money on
Whom they've met with
Where they've shown identification papers to the authorities

entries: If your Bastion is mobile, it takes time to establish this network of agents in a new place. When your Bastion is traveling, you can't issue the Research order to this facility. After it arrives at its destination, the first time you issue the Research order, this facility's hireling spends 7 days establishing a new network, after which you can use the Research order normally.

facility.name: Kundarak Vault
entries: A Kundarak Vault occupies space in your Bastion like any other special facility, but it is an extradimensional space that can be accessed from other places. As a Kundarak facility, it provides exceptionally secure storage for your trade goods and other treasures. Only you and your Bastion's hirelings can open the vault door.

entries.name: Kundarak Access
entries: Because the vault is an extradimensional space, you (and only you) can access its contents from any Kundarak bank facility in the world. These banks are found in cities across {@book Khorvaire|ERLW|5|Nations of Khorvaire} (and also in {@book Stormreach, in Xen'drik|ERLW|6|Notable Locations|2}).

entries.name: Trade: Goods
entries: When you issue the Trade order to this facility, its hireling spends the next 7 days procuring nonmagical items that have a total value of 2,000 GP or less and stores them in the Kundarak Vault, or the hireling uses those 7 days to sell goods in the Kundarak Vault. You bear the total cost of any purchases, and the maximum value of the items purchased increases to 5,000 GP when you reach level 13.

When you sell goods from your Kundarak Vault, the buyer pays you 20 percent more than the standard price; this profit increases to 50 percent when you reach level 13 and 100 percent when you reach level 17.

facility.name: Lightning Generator
entries: A Lightning Generator can transform atmospheric electricity to serve a variety of useful functions.

entries.name: Charm of Electromancy
entries: After spending a Long Rest in your Lightning Generator, you take {@damage 8d6} Lightning damage and you gain a magical {@reward Charm of Electromancy|RHW|Charm} that lasts for 7 days (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG} for rules on {@book Charms|XDMG|2|Charms}). The Charm has 3 charges. You can expend 1 charge from the Charm to cast the {@spell Telekinesis|XPHB} spell. Once all its charges are expended, the Charm vanishes from you.

entries.name: Revivification
entries: When you cast the spell {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB} and {@spell Resurrection|XPHB} while in this facility, the cost of that spell's Material components are reduced by 1,000 GP (minimum of 0).

entries.name: Empower: Lightning Life
entries: The facility's hireling channels the Generator's energy to cast {@spell Animate Objects|XPHB}, targeting one Large or Huge object of your choice in the Bastion. The spell's duration is 7 days and doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

facility.name: Liminal Space
entries: Your Bastion becomes connected to an unfathomable demiplane filled with vast, empty spaces and strange beings. This special facility doesn't take up space in your Bastion; instead, the entrance to this facility appears in the closets, crawlspaces, and shadows of your Bastion's other basic and special facilities. The hireling in charge of this facility protects the Bastion's inhabitants from stray entities that slip out from the demiplane. This facility always counts as Haunted.

entries.name: Dark Bargains
entries: You can enter this facility and wander within for 7 days, consulting and bargaining with the strange entities there. If you leave the Bastion during this time, you gain no benefit. At the end of the seventh day, you gain a {@filter Dark Gift|feats|category=DG} feat of your choice. You can only have one feat from this benefit at a time; if you use this benefit when you already have a feat from it, the feat you gain at the end of the seven days replaces any feat previously gained from use of this facility.

entries.name: Recruit: Stranger
entries: When you issue the Recruit order to this facility, you instruct the facility's hireling to conduct a ritual and petition an entity from the demiplane for aid. This ritual takes 7 days and costs 1,000 GP. At the ritual's end, roll any die. On an odd number, the summoned entity refuses your request and kills the hireling, and this facility can't be used until your next Bastion turn, at which point the hireling is replaced at no cost to you; on an even number, the summoned entity agrees to your request and takes up residence in your Liminal Space.

While residing in your Liminal Space, an entity counts as a Bastion Defender, and if your Bastion is attacked, each entity in your Liminal Space reduces by 1 the number of dice you roll to determine how many Bastion Defenders are lost in the attack. You can choose not to count the entity as a Bastion Defender, in which case you can't call on it to defend the Bastion; instead, the entity acts according to its nature, using the {@creature Unspeakable Horror|RHW} stat block. You can have up to three entities in your Liminal Space at a time. Deduct any you lose from your Bastion Defenders roster.

facility.name: Lyrandar Helm
entries: A Lyrandar Helm allows a mobile Bastion built within an elemental airship or an elemental galleon to travel. This facility's hireling is a {@book dragonmarked heir of House Lyrandar|EFA|5|House Lyrandar}. On an elemental airship, the airship's {@book Helm|EFA|7|Helm} crew station is part of this facility (see {@book chapter 7|EFA|7|Crew Members and Stations}).

entries.name: Empower: Travel
entries: When you issue the Empower order to this facility, you instruct its hireling to pilot the Bastion to a destination you specify. The Bastion travels at the vehicle's speed, 8 hours per day, for the duration of the Bastion turn. The Bastion stops early when it reaches the specified destination or if something happens to stop your travel.
When you issue the Empower order to this facility, the DM rolls on the {@book Bastion Events table|XDMG|7|Bastion Events} as if you had issued the Maintain order to your Bastion.

facility.name: Manifest Zone
entries: A Bastion with a Manifest Zone is infused with the planar energy of one of Eberron's planes of existence. Choose the plane when you build this facility.

entries.name: Empower: Manifest Charm
entries: When you issue the Empower order to this facility, the facility's hireling conducts magical rites for the next 7 days. At the end of that period, you gain a special {@filter Charm|rewards|type=charm} (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|XDMG|2|Supernatural Gifts}" in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}) called a Manifest Charm, which lasts until you use it. You don't need to be in the Bastion while the rites are performed to gain their benefit. The effects of the Charm depend on the facility's linked plane:

items: {@reward Manifest Charm of Daanvi, the Perfect Order|EFA} ({@book Daanvi, the Perfect Order|ERLW|10|Daanvi, the Perfect Order})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Dolurrh, the Realm of the Dead|EFA} ({@book Dolurrh, the Realm of the Dead|ERLW|10|Dolurrh, the Realm of the Dead})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Fernia, the Sea of Fire|EFA} ({@book Fernia, the Sea of Fire|ERLW|10|Fernia, the Sea of Fire})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Irian, the Eternal Dawn|EFA} ({@book Irian, the Eternal Dawn|ERLW|10|Irian, the Eternal Dawn})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Lamannia, the Twilight Forest|EFA} ({@book Lamannia, the Twilight Forest|ERLW|10|Lamannia, the Twilight Forest})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Mabar, the Endless Night|EFA} ({@book Mabar, the Endless Night|ERLW|10|Mabar, the Endless Night})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Risia, the Plain of Ice|EFA} ({@book Risia, the Plain of Ice|ERLW|10|Risia, the Plain of Ice})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Shavarath, the Battleground|EFA} ({@book Shavarath, the Battleground|ERLW|10|Shavarath, the Battleground})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Syrania, the Azure Sky|EFA} ({@book Syrania, the Azure Sky|ERLW|10|Syrania, the Azure Sky})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Thelanis, the Faerie Court|EFA} ({@book Thelanis, the Faerie Court|ERLW|10|Thelanis, the Faerie Court})
{@reward Manifest Charm of Xoriat, the Realm of Delirium|EFA} ({@book Xoriat, the Realm of Delirium|ERLW|10|Xoriat, the Realm of Madness})

entries: If your Bastion is mobile, its connection to the linked plane of existence is suspended while the Bastion moves, and you can't issue the Empower order to this facility while it is in transit. When the Bastion reaches a destination, you can issue the Empower order to establish a new planar connection, linking the Bastion either to the same plane of existence or to a different one you choose. Establishing the new connection takes 7 days, after which you can issue the Empower order normally.

facility.name: Museum
entries: A Museum contains relics and treasures brought back from expeditions you participated in or sponsored, carefully cataloged and displayed.

entries.name: Research: Specialized Lore
entries: When you issue the Research order to this facility, you commission the hireling to study particular treasures in the museum. The work takes 7 days. The hireling gains knowledge regarding some question of ancient history as if they had cast the {@spell Legend Lore|XPHB} spell, then shares this knowledge with you the next time you speak with them.

entries.name: Secrets of the Past
entries: Your Museum contains one treasure that gives you a magical {@filter Charm|rewards|type=charm} (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|XDMG|2|Supernatural Gifts}" in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}) when you spend 7 days studying it and then finish a Long Rest in your Bastion. The Charm lasts for 7 days or until you use it. You can't gain another Charm from this facility while you still have one. The effect of the Charm depends on the origin of the treasure in your Museum. You can choose one of the following options (your DM might make more options available or limit the existing options based on your past expeditions):

items: {@reward Charm of Argonnessen|EFA}
{@reward Charm of Ashtakala|EFA}
{@reward Charm of Dhakaan|EFA}
{@reward Charm of Khyber|EFA}
{@reward Charm of Xen'drik|EFA}

entries.name: Enlarging the Facility
entries: You can enlarge your Museum to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. If you do so, the Museum can have two treasures with different origins. A Vast Museum gains two additional hirelings, for a total of three. Assign names and personalities to them as you see fit.

facility.name: Navigator's Helm
entries: A Navigator's Helm allows a mobile Bastion built within a mundane waterborne vehicle to travel.

entries.name: Empower: Travel
entries: When you issue the Empower order to this facility, you instruct its hireling to pilot the Bastion to a destination you specify. The Bastion sails at the vehicle's speed, 8 hours per day, for the duration of the Bastion turn. The Bastion stops early when it reaches the specified destination or if something happens to stop your travel.
When you issue the Empower order to this facility, the DM rolls on the {@book Bastion Events table|XDMG|7|Bastion Events} as if you had issued the Maintain order to your Bastion.

facility.name: Orien Helm
entries: An Orien Helm allows a mobile Bastion built within a Lightning Rail cart to travel. This facility's hireling is a {@book dragonmarked heir of House Orien|EFA|5|House Orien}.

entries.name: Empower: Travel
entries: When you issue the Empower order to this facility, you instruct its hireling to pilot the Bastion to a destination you specify. The Bastion travels at a rate of 30 miles per hour, 8 hours per day, along an existing route of conductor stones for the duration of the Bastion turn. The Bastion stops early when it reaches the specified destination or if something happens to stop your travel.
When you issue the Empower order to this facility, the DM rolls on the {@book Bastion Events table|XDMG|7|Bastion Events} as if you had issued the Maintain order to your Bastion.

facility.name: Rookery
entries: A number of ravens equal to your character level roost in a Rookery. Whenever a creature enters the facility, the birds uncannily track its movement, an unfathomable intelligence behind their beady eyes.

entries.name: Craft: Mist Talisman
entries: When you issue the Craft order to this facility, you can commission the hireling to send ravens to various contacts in a Domain of Dread you have either visited previously or heard about from a creature that has been within said domain. This work takes 21 days, during which time no other activity can occur within this facility.
At the end of this period, the hireling produces a {@book Mist talisman|RHW|0|Mist Talismans} linked to the chosen Domain of Dread.

entries.name: Messenger Ravens
entries: Whenever you finish a Long Rest in your Bastion, you can send one raven bearing a written message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. After receiving this message, the recipient can reply in a like manner, attaching their response to the raven. Regardless of whether or not the recipient responds, the raven returns to the rookery after 7 days have passed.

You can send a message via raven in this way across any distance, though the message recipient must be on the same plane of existence as your Bastion or in a demiplane linked to yours by the Mists of Ravenloft. A messenger raven delivers the message regardless of any magical wards or other interposing forces, including the Mists and closed borders of a Domain of Dread. If the raven is unable to deliver your message, it returns to your rookery after 7 days with your original message still attached.

facility.name: Spirit Vault
entries: A Spirit Vault is magically warded to imprison and exorcise malevolent spirits and other supernatural forces. Haunted portraits, cursed relics, and other eerie curios line the shelves of this dark vault. This facility always counts as Haunted.

entries.name: Esoteric Knowledge
entries: After spending a Long Rest in your Spirit Vault, you gain one of the following magical Charms:

items: {@reward Charm of Exorcism|RHW}
{@reward Charm of Malediction|RHW}

entries: The Charm lasts for 7 days or until you use it. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the Charm's spells (choose each time you gain this Charm).

entries.name: Research: Ask the Occult
entries: When you issue the Research order to this facility, you or its hireling study the various relics and question the imprisoned entities within your Spirit Vault. This work takes 7 days. At the end of this time, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 1, the work is psychically taxing; if you did the research, you take {@damage 6d6} Psychic damage, and if the hireling did the research, they immediately die, and this facility can't be used again until your next Bastion turn. Otherwise, you or the hireling gain information as if you had successfully cast the {@spell Contact Other Plane|XPHB} spell. The hireling shares any information they learned with you the next time you speak.

facility.name: Séance Parlor
entries: The veil between the world of the living and the dead grows thin in a Séance Parlor.

entries.name: Research: Fortune Telling
entries: When you issue the Research order to this facility, you commission its hireling to read your fortune by casting bones, interpreting tea leaves, performing a tarokka reading, or using some other means. After your fortune is read, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. You can't gain this benefit again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Speak with Dead
entries: After spending a Long Rest in your Séance Parlor, you can cast {@spell Speak with Dead|XPHB} immediately without expending a spell slot or needing Material components. When you cast it in this way, you can target any deceased creature whose name you know, as long as you have a piece of its remains (such as ashes or a bone) or an object that was important to the creature in life (such as a brooch or signature weapon). The target speaks through an implement in the Séance Room such as a crystal ball or spirit board.
